did: Built step 3 of the weekly engagement report: the template that turns a week's report into a video, the /report stage it is recorded from, and record:report, which reads home's own counts for the week and records it with no writer. A whole-registry week recorded locally in about four minutes with nothing cut off, and the sample's preview came out the same bytes twice. The ledger now places the report's coming server worker, so step 4 on home can start.

calls.title: Lines with fewer than 5 of anything are counted together, not read out
options: read out every line's own sentence
count quiet and unrecorded lines together, reading out the rest
leave quiet lines out of the video
calls.why: Only a few lines are used today, so reading each quiet one aloud would fill most of the video with the same sentence, and leaving them out would hide what the app offered.
calls.undo: Make pageSaid in engagement-report-video.ts read every line's own words (C190).

calls.title: A week still under way is never made into a report
options: refuse a week still under way
calls.why: A week under way gives a different report each time it is read, and the report promises the same records give the same video.
calls.undo: Drop the complete check in reportWeeksOf (C191).

left: Step 4, home's report worker and render job, is server#821's. Home's preview list also needs engagement-report before Studio's Make a preview works for this template.
Step 5, the phone's Calls screen offering the report, waits on step 4.
